cve_summary: The ff_amf_get_field_value function in libavformat/rtmppkt.c in FFmpeg 3.3.2 allows remote RTMP servers to cause a denial of service (Segmentation Violation and application crash) via a crafted stream.
commit_message:
avformat/rtmppkt: Convert ff_amf_get_field_value() to bytestream2

Fixes: out of array accesses

Found-by: JunDong Xie of Ant-financial Light-Year Security Lab
Signed-off-by: Michael Niedermayer <michael@niedermayer.cc>
docstring:
```plaintext
Summary: Retrieves the value of a specified field from an AMF data stream.

Parameters:
data (const uint8_t*): Pointer to the start of the data stream.
data_end (const uint8_t*): Pointer to the end of the data stream.
name (const uint8_t*): The name of the field to retrieve.
dst (uint8_t*): Buffer to store the retrieved field value.
dst_size (int): Size of the destination buffer.

Returns: int: Returns 0 on success, or -1 on failure.

Logic: The function initializes a byte stream context and calls a helper function to extract the field value. It checks for valid data boundaries, processes the AMF data types, and populates the destination buffer with the corresponding value based on the field name. If the field is not found or an error occurs during processing, it returns -1.
```
extraction_reason: vulnerable-side scope spans 2 top-level constructs (functions/declarations), not a single function
